methodology.reliabilityRule: Each directional signal is shrunk toward 50%; non-verified fixtures are capped at 0.35 reliability.
methodology.confidenceRule: High requires ≥70% model probability, official fixture verification, ≥0.85 applied reliability, and a unique source-grounded analysis of at least 30 words.
methodology.pricesRule: Fair decimal odds are 1 ÷ model probability with no overround. Handicap and total values are model midpoints, not scraped bookmaker quotes.
